[P3] Resolve the example's missing branch test under rule 4

The new handler adds an escalation branch, but no test exercises this example. Existing AI tests cover individual operations; removing or inverting this condition would leave their assertions unchanged. This violates **Rule 4 — Every branch has a test that fails without it**, leaving the documented branching behavior unprotected. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, to agree on a tested example or a simpler presentation, as rule 9 requires.
